salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). Memento (context folding with backtracking for long-document QA; LiteraryQA, NovelHopQA, NovelQA, SagaScale). Table 1 rows of GPT-5.5 High: the Full Context reference (232K context) and the Fold + Backtrack harness of the authors (reference rows, not trained). Cells: LitQA, NHopQA, NovelQA, Saga accuracy and Micro Avg (5 measures per row); Tokens (mean per rollout) as usage and Cost ($, full test set) as spend. DOUBT kept: the dagger rows were 'evaluated on up to 100 random questions per dataset; cost is extrapolated to the full test set' (sample, extrapolated cost). The effort 'High' is written in the row label. Route not written.
